milestones.title: The Golden Topper brand was founded
milestones.desc: The brand was founded in early 2013 by an assemblage of experienced technical professionals coming from established real estate developers in Mainland China.

milestones.title: The brand expanded to the Philippines
milestones.desc: GT branched out to the Philippines, setting its sights on the country’s two regions — Luzon and Visayas, headed by its President, Mr. Allan Crisologo.

milestones.title: Corporate launching celebration
milestones.desc: A remarkable milestone, the Group of Companies hosted its grand launch event, unveiling its planned projects to esteemed guests.

milestones.title: Acquired Regent Construction International
milestones.desc: With its own construction arm, Regent Construction International, Inc., a triple A contractor, Golden Topper aims to be an active player in developing urban projects.

milestones.title: Best Developer in Cebu Award
milestones.desc: In recognition of its projects in the Cebu province, City Clou and El Sol, Golden Topper accepted the award for Best Developer in Cebu at the Dot Property Awards 2022.

milestones.title: Local Social Welfare Initiative of the Year
milestones.desc: The Group received the award for Local Social Welfare Initiative - Philippines 2023 at the Gov Media Awards for its contribution in the Naga Housing Project.
